config.description: JSON object with model parameters or any agent configuration to store with this version. If omitted, the current version's config is carried forward; pass null to clear it. Can be combined with either prompt or edits. Don't store secrets here: config is returned to anyone who can read the prompt.

edits.description: List of find/replace operations to apply to the current prompt version. Each edit's 'old' text must match exactly once. Edits are applied sequentially. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

old.description: Text to find in the current prompt. Must match exactly once.

prompt.description: Full prompt payload to publish as a new version. Mutually exclusive with edits.

version_description.description: Optional note describing what changed in this version. Shown in the version history.
